blocks.text: Jeremiah 28 contains 17 verses. It opens with: And it came to pass the same year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah the son of Azzur, the prophet, who was of Gibeon, spake unto me in the house of Jehovah, in the presence of the priests and of all the people, saying, It concludes with: So Hananiah the prophet died the same year in the seventh month.
